walkthrough.spec: tests/qa-look.spec.ts (copied from the template, deleted after the pass)
areas: Settings › Request topics: a curator (admin) opens the catalogue, sees the Staff/Client audience switch and the topics list — screenshot admin-settings-request-topics.png
A requester (user) sees no 'Request topics' sidebar row and is bounced from the direct route to /org/{orgId}/members — screenshot user-settings-request-topics-redirected.png

Raising a request: the requester picks a topic in the New request modal, the created row and the detail screen both show the topic's snapshot name (VPN) — screenshots requester-new-request-modal.png, requester-requests-list-with-topic.png, requester-request-detail-topic.png
The same request, viewed by the admin, shows the identical topic label on the list row — screenshot admin-requests-list-with-topic.png

Archiving a topic (VPN) removes it from the New request picker (status=active) but the requests list's topic filter still offers it, marked '(archived)' (status=all) — screenshots admin-new-request-picker-without-archived-vpn.png, admin-requests-topic-filter-shows-archived.png
walkthrough.result: No defect found. All screens matched the spec's stated behaviour; screenshots discarded with the deleted walkthrough spec, described here as required.
